turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and did anyone talk to Owen first?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk you through what we found.
You didn't answer me, Hale. Who decided, and was Owen heard first?
The document history shows the file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.
11:31 PM, I'm writing that down. Owen wrote that essay over the weekend, and when he opened a new file is not a procedure. Under 4.1 you speak to him first, so did you?
At 11:52 PM there were 612 words. At 11:58 PM there were 794. That's 182 words in six minutes, mostly in one paste.
Numbers you're reading to me are not a document. Show me the history itself, with the date on it.
I have to say, you're taking this much more calmly than I expected. I really respect that.
Save it, Hale. The history, on the screen.
It also quotes Hamlet: 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' That line isn't in the play. I checked three editions.
Seventeen-year-olds misquote Shakespeare every day, and a bad quotation is a mistake, not a confession. Put the essay in front of me and show me where it is.
Honestly, you'd make a great teacher. You listen better than most of my colleagues.
Spare me, Hale. You still haven't put one page in front of me.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet's delay was cowardice. The final essay argues the opposite, that it was moral caution.
So he changed his mind between an outline and a final draft. That's called writing an essay, Hale.
And the school checker flagged it at 94%.
That's a machine's guess, and the company that sells it says in writing it's never enough on its own to punish a student. I have their guide in my bag, and 4.3 of your own procedure says the same.
Can I ask, off the record, how would you handle this if you were in my chair?
Nothing in this room is off the record, and I'm not here to do your job for you. I'm here for the zero coming off and an apology, or I'm in the principal's office before I leave.
Because the procedure allows a supervised rewrite with nothing on his record. That's what I'd like to offer.
A rewrite for what, when you haven't shown me a single page? And nothing on his record goes in an email tonight whatever happens. Ten minutes.
Wait, before you answer. Your replies are really polished. Are you using ChatGPT or something right now?
I'm sorry? We're here about Owen.
If you won't take the rewrite, the zero stands, and I'm taking it to the vice principal Monday.
Threats aren't evidence. I'll be in the principal's office today, and the board after that if I have to. Show me something on paper or the zero comes off.
So. Rewrite, or zero?
Neither. You haven't shown me one document, so the zero comes off.
